newsitem.title: CHINA: Large earthquake jolts northwest China region.
newsitem.headline: Large earthquake jolts northwest China region.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 6.4 on the Richter scale jolted China's northwestern Xinjiang region on Sunday, state television reported.
There were no immediate reports of casualties or damage.
At least eight people were injured and a number of houses collapsed, the Xinhua news agency said in a report issued after the television announcement.
The earthquake struck the cotton-growing region of Jiashi at 12.36 p.m. (0436 GMT), state television said.
An earthquake of magnitude 6.3 struck Jiashi at 7.46 a.m. on Sunday (2346 GMT Saturday), Xinhua said.
An earthquake measuring 6.4 on the Richter scale killed about 50 people in Jiashi in January and the region has been rocked by hundreds of aftershocks.
